items.name: Prism (this repository)
items.notes: Prism's own code, tokens, specs and docs (ADR-0028). Third-party files keep their own licenses: every item below, bundled with its license text.

items.name: Onest
items.notes: Signature preset ui/display. Bundle OFL.txt next to the font.

items.name: JetBrains Mono
items.attribution: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
items.notes: Signature preset mono; google/fonts build, pinned by ADR-0021.

items.name: Inter
items.notes: Native preset, web only: self-hosted woff2 built from upstream InterVariable.ttf in brands/prism-native/fonts/inter/ (from the Inter-4.1.zip release asset, whose LICENSE.txt is the OFL.txt beside it); never loaded from Google Fonts (ADR-0020).

items.name: Phosphor Icons
items.notes: Web icons and generated Apple asset catalog for custom symbols.

items.name: SF Symbols 7
items.notes: Referenced by name from Swift code only; never in web package, docs, Tokens Studio export or Figma web frames.

items.name: SF Pro / SF Compact / SF Mono
items.notes: Used through Font.system on Apple platforms only; never bundled.

items.name: Simple Design System
items.attribution: Simple Design System by Figma, CC BY 4.0
items.notes: Structural checklist: component inventory, slots, variables model.

items.name: Material 3 Design Kit
items.attribution: Material 3 Design Kit by Google, CC BY 4.0
items.notes: Structural checklist: state matrix, density axes.

items.name: Adobe spectrum-design-data
items.notes: Reference for component schemas and token data structure; NOTICE preserved if adapted.

items.name: DTCG Format and Resolver JSON Schemas
items.notes: format.json and resolver.json as published at designtokens.org/schemas/2025.10 (the schemas/ package of the source repository), vendored byte-identical in tools/tokens/schema/dtcg-2025.10/ with LICENSE.md (the full W3C Software and Document Notice and License) and SHA256SUMS; tokens:validate reads them offline and no Prism package ships them (ADR-0024 §10). The source repository licenses its reports under the W3C Software and Document License and takes contributed software under the W3C 3-clause BSD License.

items.name: Untitled UI FREE v2.0
items.notes: Creator license forbids use inside a distributed design system; read for inventory breadth only.

items.name: Apple iOS and iPadOS 26 / macOS 26 / watchOS 26 kits
items.notes: Canonical control and state inventory for Apple platforms; never derive web assets from it.

items.name: Atlassian Design System libraries
items.notes: Licensed only for Atlassian-integrated add-ons; token naming ideas only.
